purpose: Prepare typed audiovisual identities, catalogue indexing, explicit episode progress and a compatible backup container before importing new formats.

identity.externalAliases: The 983 reviewed movie links resolve to the same preserved local movie record. The 17 unlinked movies remain local without guessed IDs.
identity.classification: Anime, animation, documentary, reality, competition, telenovela, miniseries, short and special are reviewed classifications on one record, not duplicate catalogue identities.
identity.canonicalResolutionGate: Future UI and persistence integration must resolve verified aliases to the canonical catalogue key before saving edits; backup validation alone does not deduplicate unknown identities.

progress.episodeIdentity: Parent TV identity plus explicit season and episode numbers; season zero is allowed for specials.
progress.completion: Episode and season completion never silently marks the entire series completed. Unknown or empty episode counts cannot prove completion.
progress.runtime: Film minutes and episode minutes have explicit scopes. Unknown runtime stays unknown; season and series durations are not inferred.

backup.contents: An exact six-key PersonalStorageSnapshot plus a separately versioned media-progress snapshot.
backup.compatibility: Existing legacy/v1-v4 importers and the complete raw snapshot importer are unchanged. The new envelope is preparation only and is not accepted by the current app UI.
backup.unknownData: Preserve exact legacy raw strings and valid typed progress for identities absent from the current catalogue. Unsupported envelopes or new structured fields reject the whole operation, without returning a reduced replacement.
backup.integrationGate: Before activation, define versioned native storage and an atomic migration/export/restore path for the new progress. Do not hide progress in a legacy raw key or write reduced JSON over preserved values.

realDeviceEvidence.basis: User reports in the project conversation; no personal backup or database was inspected.
2026-10-23: Complete backup export and restore confirmed, including prior volume and removal of a test favorite
2026-10-24: Basic airplane-mode library and favorite save/reopen confirmed
Posters did not load without internet
realDeviceEvidence.posterImplementation: The existing explicit Cache Storage/service-worker downloader is web-only; availableOffline intentionally returns false on native platforms. Native poster caching is still a separate task.
remaining: Failure recovery and representative performance on physical devices
